summary: ENGTRØ HOLDING AS (org. no. 993 789 496) is a private limited company (AS) based in Lillestrøm, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2009-02-25. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 43.222 (Kuldeanlegg-, varmepumpearbeid og installasjon av peiser); it has 0 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) net income was NOK 1.7 m. CEO: Hågen Engtrø; board chair: Hågen Engtrø; auditor: HEPSØ REVISJON AS.
